conditional.text: Earlier you said it matters to you not to harm others through your actions.
Earlier you said it matters to you not to lie to yourself even when it's uncomfortable.
Earlier you said that when you realize you're doing something harmful to others, you look for how to change that.
Earlier you said that when you encounter a truth that would require you to change your relationship with your surroundings, you consider it important to face it even if it's uncomfortable.
However, you've now chosen to keep participating in injustice.
However, you've now chosen to keep ignoring the truth because it's uncomfortable.
However, your choice now is to ignore the harm you cause to others.
However, you've now chosen to keep ignoring it because it's uncomfortable.
Would you still like to know?

reject.label: I still don't want to know
